paper_id: He et al. - 2021 - RED RFID-Based Eccentricity Detection for High-Speed Rotating Machinery
title: Fast Weighted Total Variation Regularization Algorithm for Blur Identification and Image Restoration
motivation: Images in unconstrained environments suffer from unknown blur kernels and noise, requiring blind restoration.
problem_framing: Jointly estimate unknown image and blur kernel by minimizing TV regularized objective, unlike alternating optimization.
key_insight: Local linearization around current estimates preserves convexity, enabling decomposition into two fast denoising subproblems.
method_signature: Joint estimation via proximal gradient with separable TV denoising subproblems
evaluation_criteria: PSNR, SSIM improvement and convergence time comparison on synthetic/natural grayscale/color images
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: The alternate minimization algorithm has convergence issues and quality degradation per [15] and [33].
